studies.title: From 3 hours to 30 seconds: how DPS automated daily fee reconciliation
studies.summary: Daily collection reports across 1,400 students used to take 3 hours of clerical work. After Friensys, the principal sees them at her desk by 9:30 AM, end of day.

studies.title: 1,800 parents, one app: how Genius Public cut office calls by 70%
studies.summary: Parents had been calling the front desk for every attendance and fee query. After rolling out the Friensys School App, daily call volume fell from ~120 to ~35.

studies.title: Why a CBSE residential school evaluated 5 vendors and chose modular
studies.summary: Adhyayan needed hostel + transport on day one but didn't want a full ERP rewrite. With Friensys's modular pricing, they bought what they needed and added later.
